value.rationale: Zero-disjointness from the identity section is a canonical geometric condition. The finite height bound is forced by Shioda geometry, and the exact 1212 count exhausts a natural invariant. The 204 minimum-section weighted intersection graph has nontrivial four intersection levels, a sharply regular 206 weighted degree and an exact five-level integral spectrum derivable from rank-12 lattice moments. This is structural geometric incidence information beyond a routine basis change, a narrow arbitrary norm slice or a restatement of earlier 12-section data.
